dedupe_keys.name: application of genetic algorithm to a gas network for flow optimization

description: The deposit contains Java code for genetic optimisation of gas-network flows. It encodes flows as genes and seeks pressure-drop reductions across loops and compressor stations, with documented population and mutation parameters. The provider is Matthew Efe Takerhi. Coverage: The example describes a small gas-network configuration. Its real-world location, calibration period and numerical time resolution are not established. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. The public deposit provides a free access route; downstream software and third-party data may have separate conditions. Limitations: The instructions depend on a particular class setup and fitness function. Convergence quality and transfer to other networks were not tested. For simulation it offers a worked optimisation implementation for comparison with other gas-network algorithms. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
